deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for service=redwood-runtime env=prod-usw commit=a1b2c3d4 tag=release/v1.12.0-canary-2026-03-20 traffic=2% sample=1000 window=10m

ellie: starting watches, will post a quick smoke in ~5m

kevin: noted. dashboards up at https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/canary — watching p95 and error budget

sre-oncall: assigned. threshold: if errors >= 3% over 10m -> rollback. ping me on pager if anomaly

deploy-bot: Canary smoke results: duration=10m samples=1003 p50=82ms (+2ms) p95=310ms (+15ms) errors=0.4% (baseline 0.3%) cost-per-token +0.6%

maria: looks fine from traces, no tail latency spikes on long-context traces

ellie: exercised 4096 token path and rerank endpoint, traces look clean

kevin: propose promote to 10% for 30m to increase confidence

sre-oncall: +1 for gradual ramp, keep tight alerting and rollback criteria

release-manager: OK to promote to 10%. If 10% holds for 30m without infra regressions we'll consider step up. Will prepare release note skeleton

deploy-bot: Promoting canary -> 10% traffic in prod-usw. ramp_policy=rp-331 starting. will report at checkpoint or on anomalies

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: target=10% reached commit=a1b2c3d4 tag=release/v1.12.0-canary-2026-03-20

ellie: quick pass: p95 +12ms but within SLO. no user-facing errors detected

sre-oncall: alerts steady, continuing to monitor

deploy-bot: 30m checkpoint: samples=12,345 p50=85ms p95=318ms errors=0.5% decision: recommend promote to 50% unless objections in 10m

kevin: approve promote to 50% if no objections from infra/developers in 10m

maria: approve, I'll draft release note text (short TL;DR + changelog bullets)

release-manager: Proceed to 50%. After 50% stable for 1h we will lock tag `release/v1.12.0` and cut the release notes

deploy-bot: Starting ramp to 50% traffic. policy=rp-331 step=2 target=50% ETA=15m

deploy-bot: Ramp to 50% complete. commit=a1b2c3d4

ellie: all smoke checks pass, no rollout blockers seen

release-manager: Draft release note snippet:
- Performance: improved prefix KV cache handling, lower p50 for short requests
- Serving: kernel selection heuristics tuned for mixed-sequence workloads
- Ops: safer ramp policy with automatic fallback on error budget breach
No customer-visible API changes; rollout opt-in via new tag

release-manager: Locking tag to `release/v1.12.0` and creating release entry at /release-notes/v1.12.0

kevin: FYI change window scheduled 02:00–04:00 UTC tomorrow for final cutover

sre-oncall: maintenance window logged on the incident board

deploy-bot: Canary deploy sequence finished. final_state=rolled-forward commit=a1b2c3d4 tag=release/v1.12.0 promoted_traffic=50% artifacts=sha256:deadbeef

ellie: thanks team :tada:

maria: added release note TL;DR to docs page and linked the confluence entry

release-manager: closing thread — reopen if follow-ups. :rocket:
